safety.claimScope: page-level exact-origin confinement; no claim of global host no-egress
safety.toolInvocation: none — page-declared tool payloads are untrusted data; no invokeTool/cancelInvocation/executeTool/submit
safety.minimalEnv: HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME redirected to temp dir (isolates Arch chromium-flags.conf)
safety.dataNavigationExemption: top-level data: navigations admitted for the data-url divergence case only
